identity.description:
Report an approval with no body in the PR watch

## Summary

The watch that follows a PR after the hand-over did not report an approval that had no comment text. GitHub lets a reviewer approve with an empty body, and most approvals are like that, so the project lead often did not tell the principal that a PR was approved. The watch now reports every approval. It still skips a comment-only review with no text, because that review holds only inline comments, and the watch reports those on their own.

**Ticket:** N/A
**Type:** Bug fix

---

## Agent context

### Authority

`docs/design.md` §15.110 (new) records the defect. `skills/delivered-window/references/pr-watch.md` owns the poll's command lines; `skills/delivered-window/SKILL.md` owns how a wake's lines are sorted, and already sorts an approval with no ask as a notice, so it needs no change.

### What changed, by file

- `skills/delivered-window/references/pr-watch.md`: the reviews read in the poll keeps a review when its body is not empty or its state is `APPROVED`. Both `.body` reads now default to `""`, so a null body prints an empty summary rather than `null` or an error. "What the poll leaves out" now names the approval exception and why an empty comment-only review stays out.
- `docs/design.md`: §15.110 records the defect and the fix.
- `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`: version 0.1.87 to 0.1.88.

### Constraints that applied

- A change to `skills/` bumps both manifests, to equal values. Done.
- A rule lives in one file: the sort rule stays in `SKILL.md`; only the poll changed.

### How this was verified

Ran the new `jq` filter with `SINCE=2026-10-22T00:00:00Z` against seven sample reviews. It printed an `APPROVED` review with body `""` and one with body `null`, printed a `CHANGES_REQUESTED` review with its first line, and printed the `PENDING` id.
